column3: “The Levitical priests” renders “the priests, the Levites”; “the Lord’s offerings by fire” uses a lowercase “Lord” for “Yahweh,” and “His portion” renders “His inheritance.”
NASB uses plural “they … their” for the Hebrew singular “he … his”; “promised” renders “spoke.”
“due” renders “right”; “shoulder” renders “arm,” and “they shall give” is plural for the Hebrew singular “he shall give.”
“first fruits” renders “first”; “first shearing” renders “first of the fleece.”
“him and his sons” renders “he and his descendants”; “forever” renders “all the days.”
“resides” renders “sojourns”; “whenever he desires” renders “with all the desire of his soul.”
“his fellow Levites” renders “his relatives the Levites.”
“equal portions” renders “portion like portion”; “what they receive from the sale of their fathers’ estates” interprets an obscure Hebrew phrase, “his sales on the fathers.”
“imitate” renders “do according to”; “detestable things” renders “abominations.”
“practices witchcraft” and “interprets omens” render two terms for occult practice whose exact meaning is uncertain.
“a medium, or a spiritist” renders “one who asks a necromancer and a familiar spirit”; “calls up the dead” renders “inquires of the dead.”
“detestable” renders “abomination”; “drive them out” renders “dispossess them.”
“before” renders “with.”
“those who practice witchcraft” renders “soothsayers”; “to do so” renders “thus.”
NASB moves “like me” before “from among you.”
NASB supplies “This is”; “or I will die” renders “and I will not die.”
“They have spoken well” renders “They have done well in what they have spoken.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“require it of him” supplies “it.”
“speak a word presumptuously” renders “act presumptuously by speaking a word”; “or which” renders “and who.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“When” and “if” restructure the clauses; “come true” renders “come.”
